scan_id.description: The scan to report; absent lists scans.

shape.description: triage: one short row per file (its tier, strongest finding and counts), correctness lane by default, with the files out of scope (out_of_scope) and those an earlier version did not assess (not_assessed_by_earlier_version) in the page header; review_queue: distinct files with allegations and evidence; coverage: unknown, partial and excluded paths. summary retains legacy chunk scores and lists top_correctness; findings pages chunk evidence.

worst.description: summary: how many lowest-index legacy chunks to list (default 10), not distinct files, and how many top_correctness files.

cursor.description: findings: next_cursor of the previous page.

page_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of page entries (default 131072); metadata is additional.

min_severity.description: findings: leave out findings below this severity.

path.description: findings, review_queue, coverage or triage: a file, a folder or a glob; * within a name, ** for any depth. Dot or absent is every file. A triage row's ref here, with that row's lane, gives that file's whole evidence.

lane.description: review_queue or triage: correctness and maintainability are concern lanes (absent combines both in review_queue, correctness first; triage defaults to correctness). size lists files with a size finding by line count; slop lists files with slop findings by count, each naming its two most frequent kinds. Size and slop are maintainability findings and never move a correctness tier. Thresholds come from finding_thresholds, applied when the report is read.

tier.description: review_queue or triage of the correctness lane, or of no lane: pinned (default) is p at least 0.80 placed with at least 0.60 confidence, not context-limited, no intent stated; unpinned is the rest; intent_stated is files whose only correctness findings have a comment saying the error is ignored on purpose. Both bounds are first picks, not yet measured.

page_cursor.description: review_queue, coverage or triage: opaque next_page_cursor; changed evidence or query requires a fresh first page.

limit.description: review_queue, coverage or triage: maximum entries per page, default 20 (triage 50).

list_all.description: review_queue or triage: list every finding the default view counts and does not list (counted_not_listed): SL-FORWARD for a pass-through function that is not a same-name wrapper, and RD-04 and ST-04. Without it each page and the summary give their totals, and neither ranks a file.
